run_table_detection: run the table transformer model on an image to detect tables using HPU acceleration
run_table_detection_bf16: run the table detection example with bf16 precision enabled for faster inference on HPU
run_table_detection_hpu_graphs: run the table detection example with HPU graphs enabled for better latency
run_table_detection_custom_model: run the table detection example with a custom model name or path via --model_name_or_path
run_table_detection_custom_image: run the table detection example on a local image file specified by --filename
